entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. I see from your number that you recently purchased the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. Is that the item you're calling about?
Okay. To get started, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. And I tried to do this yesterday, but your website was broken.
My apologies for that inconvenience. We did have a known issue yesterday. So you experienced a website error when you tried to start the return?
That's what I said. The page wouldn't load, so I couldn't print the label. The whole system was down. I even have a screenshot if you don't believe me.

No, that won't be necessary at all. I can confirm our system was down for maintenance. I'm sorry you had to call in because of our technical glitch. Let me just check the policy for you. I see you received the band on January 2nd, which was 10 days ago.

Okay, looking at our knowledge base, all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that timeframe, so I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund.
Whatever. Just send me the label.

Of course. I've just emailed the pre-paid return label to the address on your account. You can just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed in 3-5 business days.
It has been sent successfully. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
